beaches.name: Kamakahonu Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use the public approach beside Kailua Pier from Aliʻi Drive and Palani Road.
beaches.description: A small sandy cove beside Kailua Pier in historic Kailua Village.

beaches.name: Turtle Bay West
beaches.access_tips: Use designated public shoreline access and trails.
beaches.description: A reef surf break on the west side of the Turtle Bay resort area.

beaches.name: Lawai Beach
beaches.access_tips: Approach from Lawai Road; the adjacent resort identifies this public shoreline destination.
beaches.description: A small beach beside the Beach House Restaurant on Kauai’s south coast.

beaches.name: Kaanapali Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use marked public beach access along Kaanapali Parkway.
beaches.description: A long sandy beach on West Maui’s resort coast, south of Black Rock.

beaches.name: Pohaku Park (S-Turns)
beaches.access_tips: Use the public park entrance on Lower Honoapiilani Road.
beaches.description: A West Maui surf park with rocky shoreline and a small sandy southern section.

beaches.name: Kaunaoa Beach
beaches.access_tips: Request a public beach parking pass at the resort entrance; spaces are limited.
beaches.description: A crescent of white sand at Kaunaʻoa Bay beside Mauna Kea Beach Hotel.

beaches.name: Napili Bay Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use signed public beach access from Napili Place or Hui Drive.
beaches.description: A sandy crescent along Nāpili Bay on Maui’s northwest coast.

beaches.name: Kamaole Beach Park II
beaches.access_tips: Reopened August11,2026 after storm repairs; respect barricades around restoration areas.
beaches.description: A sandy beach between Kamaʻole Beach Parks I and III in Kīhei.

beaches.name: Wailea Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use signed public beach access and the coastal beachwalk.
beaches.description: A sandy crescent on South Maui’s Wailea resort coastline.

beaches.name: Kihei Cove
beaches.access_tips: Use the public Cove Park shoreline entrance.
beaches.description: A small surfing cove at the south end of Kalama Park in Kīhei.

beaches.name: Sharp Park Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use Beach Boulevard access and the coastal promenade. Follow posted pier and beach notices; no lifeguard is on duty.
beaches.description: Sharp Park Beach is the public Pacifica shoreline between the municipal pier and Mori Point. The pier and beach form one coastal area, distinct from Linda Mar and Rockaway Beach.

beaches.name: Santa Cruz Main Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use public pedestrian access from Beach Street. Check current city water-quality and ocean-safety notices and ask an on-duty lifeguard about conditions.
beaches.description: Santa Cruz Main Beach, also called Boardwalk Beach, is the sandy public shoreline east of the municipal wharf and west of the San Lorenzo River.

editorial_sources.publisher: City of Santa Cruz / California State Lands Commission
Water Quality Portal / California State Water Resources Control Board

beaches.name: Roads End Beach
hazards: rising tides can cut off headland access
beaches.access_tips: Use the state recreation site beach path and required day-use parking permit. Check tides before walking around Roads End Point; rising water can cut off the cove.
warnings: rising tides can cut off headland access
beaches.description: Roads End Beach is the public ocean shoreline reached through Roads End State Recreation Site in northern Lincoln City.

editorial_sources.publisher: Water Quality Portal / Oregon Beach Monitoring Program
Google Maps satellite imagery; reviewer-derived representative surf pin

beaches.name: Muir Beach
beaches.access_tips: Reach the beach over the pedestrian bridge from the parking lot. The lagoon and surrounding riparian habitat are closed to access; stay on established beach access routes.
beaches.description: Muir Beach is a Pacific coastal cove at the mouth of Redwood Creek in Golden Gate National Recreation Area.

editorial_sources.publisher: Water Quality Portal / Southern California Coastal Water Research Project
Google Maps satellite imagery; reviewer-derived representative surf pin

beaches.name: Cowell Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use public beach access west of the wharf. Check current water-quality notices and ocean conditions with an on-duty lifeguard before entering.
beaches.description: Cowell Beach is the sandy public beach west of the Santa Cruz Municipal Wharf, below the Dream Inn and West Cliff Drive.

editorial_sources.publisher: City of Santa Cruz / California State Lands Commission
Water Quality Portal / California State Water Resources Control Board

beaches.name: Dillon Beach
beaches.access_tips: Day-use beach parking is offered by Lawson’s Landing, subject to current hours, rates and availability. Follow marked routes and restrictions protecting dunes and wetlands.
beaches.description: Dillon Beach is the ocean-facing sandy shoreline at the northern entrance to Tomales Bay. Lawson’s Landing provides one route to its southern frontage.

editorial_sources.publisher: Water Quality Portal / California State Water Resources Control Board
Google Maps satellite imagery; reviewer-derived representative surf pin

beaches.name: North Salmon Creek Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use the signed North Salmon Creek parking area and beach paths. Follow posted habitat and ocean warnings; do not trample dunes.
beaches.description: North Salmon Creek Beach is the sandy Sonoma Coast State Park shoreline north of the Salmon Creek mouth, with public access from Highway 1.

beaches.name: Kalaloch Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use designated coastal access from Highway 101 and check current park notices and tides. Stay off logs that waves can move and avoid routes that rising tides can close.
beaches.description: Kalaloch Beach is the sandy Olympic National Park shoreline around Kalaloch Creek on the southwest Olympic Peninsula.

editorial_sources.publisher: Smithsonian repository / Carlton et al. study supplement

beaches.name: Virginia Beach Oceanfront
beaches.access_tips: Use public oceanfront access and check current city surfing restrictions and lifeguard instructions.
beaches.description: Atlantic Ocean beach beside the Virginia Beach resort boardwalk. Surfing access varies by season, time and designated area.

editorial_sources.verification: Browser provider page identifies Courtyard Oceanfront/South and Norwegian Lady statue. Two screenshots show flags in changed positions with sand/ocean behind plaza; playback active. Broad Oceanfront match, limited surf-detail view.

Federal Register 24th–25th Street shoreline reference 36°51′12″N 75°58′23″W. Imagery center is ocean approximately 150 m offshore. Broad oceanfront row; preserve distinct existing pier and 1st Street Jetty.

beaches.name: Jenkinson’s Beach
beaches.access_tips: Check current daily admission or season-pass requirements. Swim only when lifeguards are on duty.
beaches.description: Sandy Atlantic beach beside Jenkinson’s Boardwalk in Point Pleasant Beach. The privately operated beach admits visitors through seasonal paid access.

editorial_sources.verification: Nest page titled Jenks Beach Cam; Play Video clicked. Two subsequent screenshots show walking people changing positions on sand and boardwalk, visible ocean. Jenkinson’s branded beach facility visible. External provider link only; not embed approval.

NJDEP Central Avenue source 40.09355,-74.03494 was on sand. Selected pin shifted east 0.00060 degrees into visible nearshore water; point-pleasant-final.png. Privately owned with paid public admission.

beaches.name: TOBAY Beach
beaches.access_tips: Confirm Town of Oyster Bay residency eligibility and parking-permit requirements before visiting.
beaches.description: Town of Oyster Bay ocean beach on Ocean Parkway, separate from the bayside TOBAY beach. Vehicle access is subject to town residency and permit rules.

editorial_sources.publisher: New York State Department of Health via Water Quality Portal

editorial_sources.verification: Town of Oyster Bay official channel TOBAY Beach Live Stream. Two screenshots show moving people and changing ocean waves beside beach pavilion; ocean side confirmed, not bay.
Official ocean monitoring coordinate, visually at nearshore ocean edge; not bay or marina. Town ownership; restricted public access does not imply private ownership.

beaches.name: Atlantic City Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use public boardwalk beach access. Check the beach patrol’s permitted surf areas before entering with a board.
beaches.description: Atlantic beach along the Atlantic City Boardwalk, represented near Virginia Avenue and Steel Pier. Surfing is limited to designated areas and beach-patrol instructions.

editorial_sources.verification: Resorts Casino Hotel Beach Camera official channel. Two screenshots show moving boardwalk pedestrians, Steel Pier structures, sand and breaking ocean visible. Broad Atlantic City Beach match; beach area partly obstructed.

Virginia Avenue station 39.35813,-74.41861 adjusted east 0.00081 degrees to nearshore swash in atlantic-city-final.png. Broad beach identity; this pin is not a claim that Virginia Avenue is a designated surf zone.

beaches.name: Main Beach (East Hampton)
beaches.access_tips: Check Village of East Hampton parking permit requirements; Town of East Hampton permits are a separate system.
beaches.description: Atlantic beach at the end of Ocean Avenue in the Village of East Hampton. Village beach-parking permit rules apply.

editorial_sources.publisher: New York State Department of Health via Water Quality Portal

editorial_sources.verification: EEOR East Hampton NY Main Beach by ErdmanVideoSystems. Description identifies Main Beach and East End Ocean Rescue. Two screenshots show walking people, changing waves and flag position. Live badge.
Official monitoring point 40.943,-72.1944 on dry sand adjusted south 0.0006 degrees to visible surf edge; east-hampton-final.png.

beaches.name: Rehoboth Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use public beach access and check current city beach conditions and surfing-area rules.
beaches.description: Atlantic Ocean beach alongside Rehoboth Beach’s boardwalk. Surfing is subject to city restrictions and designated areas.

editorial_sources.publisher: Delaware DNREC via Water Quality Portal

editorial_sources.verification: Rehoboth Boardwalk Plaza Hotel Cam. Browser two screenshots show pedestrians moving along boardwalk, sand and Atlantic water visible. Hotel branding in video. Broad Rehoboth beach match.
Official Virginia Avenue ocean monitoring site; imagery confirms nearshore water. Do not alias separate Deauville Beach.

beaches.name: St. Augustine Beach Pier
beaches.access_tips: Use county pier beach access. Check current pier conditions separately; beach access does not guarantee the pier itself is open.
beaches.description: Ocean beach adjoining the St. Johns County Ocean and Fishing Pier on Anastasia Island. The county beach access includes parking, restrooms and showers.

editorial_sources.publisher: Google Maps linked by St. Johns County

editorial_sources.verification: County map destination 29.8569986,-81.2659358 is parking. Imagery-derived pin 29.8576,-81.2640 is nearshore water north of pier; st-augustine-final.png.

beaches.name: Ocean City Beach (Maryland)
beaches.access_tips: Check the current surf-beach schedule and marked surfing areas; hotel-front beach sections are not permanently designated surf zones.
beaches.description: Atlantic beach along Ocean City, Maryland. Summer surfing uses designated rotating beach sections and other areas identified by the beach patrol.

editorial_sources.verification: Gateway Subaru Camera at The Commander Hotel. Two browser screenshots show changing breaking waves and moving people. Commander official hotel webcam page establishes 1401 Atlantic Ave Ocean City Maryland beachfront. Broad beach match, not 44th Street exact view.
Official 44th Street ocean station 38.37011386,-75.0676825; imagery nearshore water. One broad beach row for 21st Street, Commander and Days Inn research entries; pin does not locate those hotels.
Official site identifies beach webcam and hotel address at 1401 Atlantic Ave, Ocean City Maryland.

beaches.name: East Beach (St. Simons Island)
beaches.access_tips: Use the Coast Guard beach access at 4100 First Street and observe the beach warning light system.
beaches.description: Public ocean beach accessed through Coast Guard Park on St. Simons Island. Facilities include beach parking, restrooms and accessible beach mats.

editorial_sources.verification: Access reference 31.145364,-81.372025 is parking. Proposed imagery-derived nearshore pin 31.1439,-81.3688 southeast of access; final imagery shows wet nearshore sand/swash at center, adjacent to ocean. st-simons-final.png. Consider slight east shift for all-water sampling.

beaches.name: Cherie Down Park Beach
beaches.access_tips: Use Cherie Down Park’s public beach access and follow posted county beach rules.
beaches.description: Atlantic beach at Cherie Down Park in Cape Canaveral. The county park provides public beach access from Ridgewood Avenue.

editorial_sources.verification: Surf-location coordinate crosschecked against imagery and official park address; nearshore water east of park. Cape Canaveral generic webcam cannot automatically map to this park.

DO $$ BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM _catalog_gap_beaches p JOIN public.beaches b
    ON b.id <> p.id AND (lower(b.name) = lower(p.name) OR lower(b.slug) = lower(p.slug))
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Catalog gap import conflicts with existing name or slug'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM _catalog_gap_beaches p JOIN public.beaches b USING (id)
    WHERE b.name IS DISTINCT FROM p.name OR b.slug IS DISTINCT FROM p.slug
       OR b.lat IS DISTINCT FROM p.lat OR b.lon IS DISTINCT FROM p.lon
       OR b.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Catalog gap import UUID identity or coordinate conflict'; END IF;
END $$;

INSERT INTO public.beach_photos (
  beach_id,source,source_id,image_url,thumb_url,title,creator_name,creator_url,
  license_code,license_url,attribution_html,approved
)
SELECT beach_id,'wikimedia',source_id,image_url,thumb_url,title,creator_name,creator_url,
  license_code,license_url,attribution_html,true FROM photos
ON CONFLICT (beach_id,source,source_id) DO NOTHING;

DO $$
DECLARE n integer; source_n integer; photo_n integer; camera_n integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM public.beaches WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM _catalog_gap_beaches);
  SELECT count(*) INTO source_n FROM public.beach_sources WHERE beach_id IN (SELECT id FROM _catalog_gap_beaches) AND forecast_source_id='open_meteo';
  SELECT count(*) INTO photo_n FROM public.beach_photos WHERE (beach_id,source_id) IN (VALUES ('90df1267-5d2e-51b6-ba06-21e89405166c'::uuid,'File:View of Cowel Beach towards Lighthouse Point -Santa Cruz - panoramio.jpg'),('0922be9c-e437-5f0a-90a8-82588f429564'::uuid,'File:Sunset at Napili Bay, Maui.jpg'),('67def85b-7500-5ccb-bd86-7141652da53e'::uuid,'File:Kamaole Beach II Kihei Maui Hawaii (30800124747).jpg'),('75e0bd7d-f25d-54eb-b455-af99eb561200'::uuid,'File:Kaanapali Beach Maui.jpg'),('0bc849fa-7e06-5600-8176-d2fda5ecfbf0'::uuid,'File:Ocean City MD beach looking north from pier.jpeg')) AND source='wikimedia' AND approved AND deleted_at IS NULL;
  SELECT count(*) INTO camera_n FROM _catalog_gap_beaches p JOIN public.beach_sources s ON s.beach_id=p.id WHERE p.camera_url IS NOT NULL AND s.camera_url=p.camera_url;
  IF n <> 28 OR source_n <> 28 OR photo_n <> 5 OR camera_n <> 12 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Catalog gap import count mismatch: beaches %, sources %, photos %, cameras %',n,source_n,photo_n,camera_n;
  END IF;
END $$;
COMMIT;
